title: External drive benchmark
print_hint: In the print dialog, choose Save as PDF.
unknown_eta: Remaining time cannot yet be estimated
cache_limit: This bounded run does not establish speed after SSD cache exhaustion or explain thermal throttling.
sensors_limit: Temperature, SMART and negotiated link speed are unavailable unless separately collected. No cause is inferred from a slowdown alone.
method_text: File-based I/O only. direct=1 requests OS cache bypass; device cache remains. Write tests use end_fsync. MB/s = 1,000,000 bytes/s. QD is requested; achieved depth is recorded separately.
privacy: Public HTML hides full paths and serial numbers. Raw local files may contain private paths; review before sharing.
raw: Raw results are stored beside this report.
sample: Synthetic fixture — not a drive measurement
dependency_failed: fio installation or identity verification failed
unsupported: Platform or device is not supported
trash_note: Test files were moved to Trash. Space is not reclaimed until Trash is emptied.
retain_note: Test files retained. See results.json for the exact owned directory.
pdf_failed: Automatic PDF export unavailable; open HTML and use Download PDF.
recovery: Review local logs and rerun only after fixing the cause.
analysis_hint: Compare the workload relevant to your use. Repeat with the same cable, port and load to investigate differences; do not infer device health from benchmark scores.
window_method: Initial: first 5 s. Tail: final third, capped at 30 s. Slowdown candidate: 10 consecutive samples below 70% of initial speed, after 5 s. This identifies a speed change, not a cache boundary. Cache exhaustion remains unconfirmed. No SNIA conformance or steady-state claim.
footer_method: Method references: fio and SNIA; not a conformance test
partial_write: Incomplete run: total written bytes unknown; recorded lower bound
bridge_candidates: Detected bridge candidates (not associated with this target)
enclosure_unknown: Retail enclosure model unconfirmed; a controller ID is not an enclosure model.
skill_intro: An open-source Agent Skill for bounded fio drive benchmarks and multilingual offline HTML/PDF reports.
